notes.title: New Title Released
notes.notes:
We are releasing a new title, called [b]Five Likes Please[/b]. If you enjoyed playing [b]Sporadic Spire[/b], be sure to check this one out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709320/Five_Likes_Please/

[b]Five Likes Please[/b] is a fast-paced, free-to-play multiplayer arena shooter. Build your arsenal by obtaining new weapons and unlocking attachments. Obtain "likes" and buy powerful streaks, such as vehicles and power weapons. Choose from 50+ unique weapons to bring into battle, ranging from pistols to rocket launchers. You can also completely customize each one using a gunsmith system to your liking. Choose carefully from the list of attachments available in order to suit your playstyle.

There are also two paid DLC packs available for purchase:
[list]
[*] [b]Historic Weapons Pack:[/b] A pack that includes new weapons, mainly from WW1 and WW2.
[*] [b]Neon Pack:[/b] A pack that includes new futuristic-themed weapons that operate on heat rather than reloading. This pack also includes more reticules, reticule colors, weapon camos, and the ability to change any base weapon's tracer/muzzle flash color.
[/list]

notes.title: New Game and Small Update for Launch Players
notes.notes:
This is a pretty small update. People who bought the game at launch *should* now have all world types unlocked. Please let us know if this is not working if you purchased the game at launch. Sorry that this announced update took so long, we have been very busy working on the next title, Five Likes Please. This is a first-person, multiplayer shooter. We are planning on releasing the game for free, but with potential campaign DLC and in-app purchases for cosmetics. Check it out, and be sure to wishlist it: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709320/Five_Likes_Please]Five Likes Please[/url]

notes.title: Switching to Free and Compensation
notes.notes: The game is now free to play, so hop on and try it out now if you haven't. We do have plans for compensation for those who have previously purchased the game. Most likely, those who have previously purchased the game will have all of the world types unlocked, so keep an eye out for more announcements and updates! We really appreciate the support people have given us by purchase the game, and we really want to show our thanks, especially after making the game free.

notes.title: Important Announcement on Pricing
notes.notes: After much thought and consideration, we have decided to make this game free. We aim to make the game free within the next few weeks, so stay tuned for when the price changes. If you are wondering why we made this decision, in short, we want to increase our company's outreach and capture a larger player base. Thanks for all your support so far!

notes.title: Version R2.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
- Changed many turret stats to balance them.

- Switched the roles of the tesla and poison turret.

- Reworked the progression function of enemy health to an exponential function.

- Added 3 difficulties:
     - Easy
     - Medium
     - Hard

- Added a new currency called "Wave Points" denoted by a teal triangle.

- Wave points are earned each wave and at the end of the game (wave 35).

- Added several new world types to be unlocked with Wave Points:
     - Islands
     - Swamp
     - Winter
     - Corrupted Forest
     - Volcano

- Added consumable items:
     - Orbital Strike
     - Lightning Strike
     - Airstrike
     - Nuke

- Some small bugfixes

- Updated the news menu.

- Updated the credits menu for new contributors.
